text: おねえちゃんに　おしえて　もらった　ポケモン…　つよく　なったかな？

structure.jp: おねえちゃんに　おしえて　もらった　ポケモン…
structure.en: the Pokémon my big sister taught me about...

structure.jp: つよく　なったかな？
structure.en: I wonder if they got stronger?

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.span: おしえて　もらった
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb with もらう means someone did that for you; the person who did it gets に. おしえて　もらった = 'she taught me, as a favor'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: おねえちゃんに　おしえて　もらった　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. おねえちゃんに　おしえて　もらった　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon my big sister taught me about'.

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means 'I wonder', said half to yourself. つよく　なったかな = 'I wonder if they got stronger'.
